text:
mira: Heads-up — after we pushed the strict fncall validator (canary 10%) theres a spike of schema_rejects for the `search_tool` in eu-west.
devon: saw that. reject-rate ~3.1% of calls in the canary slice, mostly missing `result.items` (schema expects array).
anya: are these legit app bugs or our validator being too strict? any example payloads?
devon: pasted one from logs:
```
{\n  "error": "schema_reject",\n  "validator": "fncall_v3_strict",\n  "tool": "search_tool",\n  "reason": "missing field 'result.items'",\n  "request_id": "req-7f9b2"\n}
```
mira: several apps upstream expect `result` sometimes to be `null` for no results. our contract required `result.items` to be [] instead of null.
sam: thats a compatibility issue. We should avoid surfacing hard rejects to customers until we confirm customers can change.
anya: can we convert hard rejects into soft-fail + tag? i.e., accept but emit `validator.soft_reject=true` and sample payloads to console.
devon: implementation-wise we have two levers: 1) change validator to permissive for that tool (fast), 2) route canary traffic to fallback model/variant that does coercion. Both affect billing/quota differently.
mira: cost/quotas concern: if we accept and coerce then downstream may bill tokens anyway; if we reject we might reduce token billing but break caller flows.
sam: also need to think about RouteID attribution. If we fallback to permissive route we should mark route tag so billing maps correctly for postmortem.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout: strict-fncall-validator -> 10% -> started 2026-03-20T09:17:00Z
anya: can we add a dashboard filter: show recent schema_rejects by tool, region, and request_id with a quick link to sampled payloads? that will speed triage.
devon: I can add a telemetry metric `fncall.validator.reject_type:missing_field` and a tag `coercion_candidate:true/false`. Also increment sampled payload export to S3 for these events.
mira: immediate ops ask: pause further rollouts, revert canary to permissive for `search_tool` only, and create sampled stream for the last 100 rejects. agree?
sam: +1 on pause. prefer making it opt-in per-tool rather than global rollback.
anya: UI/Console: will make a temporary filter and surface the soft-reject toggle for product owners. also add a note about expected behavior (null -> coerced to []).
devon: plan of record:
- roll validator for `search_tool` to permissive in canary (devon)
- enable `validator.soft_reject` flag and sample 100 payloads to S3 (devon)
- add dashboard filters + note in console (anya)
- add route tag + billing attribution for this path (sam)
- freeze further validator rollouts until we have results (mira)
mira: timeline: do the revert + sampling within 30m, dashboard patch in next 3h. whos oncall if something explodes?
sam: Im oncall for next 6h.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: action requested: rollback validator for `search_tool` in eu-west canary -> scheduled (operator: devon)
devon: starting rollback now. will push permissive patch and enable sampling.
anya: creating console ticket and temporary filter now: /console/alerts?filter=fncall.validator:missing_field
mira: thanks team — keep notes in the incident page and ping #incidents if we see regressions. :thumbsup:
sam: will follow up with billing whether these coerced accepts should be billed the same. might need a meter flag.
devon: logging note: we will add `validator_action` tag (reject|soft_accept|coerce) so we can query easily.
mira: closing this slack thread for now; update the incident doc once rollback complete.
